page_topic_one_liner: Multi-agent systems — L1 frameworks, L2 enterprise platforms, L3 agent workspaces, orchestration topologies, and MCP/A2A protocols
differentiator_vs_generic: This is agent orchestration and team coordination, NOT workflow automation or solo desktop agents. Hero must be a supervisor/worker agent topology graph with handoff arrows and shared state layer — NOT a linear Zapier-style workflow or single chat bubble.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Multi-agent orchestration graph — supervisor agent node at top (accent ring), three worker agent nodes below (Researcher, Coder, Reviewer role labels blurred), directed handoff arrows between nodes, shared state/memory bar connecting all nodes at bottom
Secondary: L1/L2/L3 lane stack — three horizontal tiers labeled Framework / Platform / Workspace (blurred) with ascending governance lock icons
Tertiary: MCP tool connector lines + A2A protocol handshake icon between two agent nodes
anti_patterns: Single chat agent bubble as hero
Real vendor logos (LangGraph, Copilot Studio, Multica)
Desktop file/GUI agent metaphor (page is team orchestration)
